subject: Recap + procurement checklist / billing start for Acme trial
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@acmeco.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Trial next steps & procurement checklist

Hi Sara, great to run through the pilot goals earlier. Quick recap and next steps from today's call: 

- Trial scope: 30-day trial starting when you flip the switch; focused on the SearchAssist workflow (embedding + reranking).
- Success criteria: 10k inference requests/day with embedding recall > 0.95 on our validation set; product + ops signoff.
- Usage thresholds: we expect onboarding activity to hit ~75k tokens/day peak; let us know if you expect >200k tokens/day so we can provision.
- Procurement path: you mentioned legal prefers PO + Net30. We can accept PO with a signed quote (we'll generate the quote) or take a corporate card for immediate start. We also support AWS Marketplace purchase orders if you prefer billing through marketplace.
- Paperwork: I've attached a short trial plan and our pricing sheet. If you need SOC 2 or an updated SOW, we can send those next.

Action items:
1) Sara: share the procurement contact and whether your team prefers PO (Net30) or card / marketplace by EOD Mon (7/13).
2) Marissa (me): attach SOC 2 + draft quote (done after procurement path confirmed).
3) Michael / Jonas: stand by for onboarding kickoff once procurement path is chosen.

Attachments: trial-plan.pdf, pricing-sheet.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-1212

--
From today's thread: Avail. times for onboarding: Mon/Wed next week 10-11am PT.
From: Sara Patel <sara@acmeco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmeco.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Trial next steps & procurement checklist

Thanks Marissa, that was helpful. A few quick questions from procurement and legal: 

- Can you provide our procurement team with a short SOW and your SOC 2 report? They want to confirm data handling before issuing a PO.
- Our standard is PO + Net30. Are there any minimums or advance payments required for a trial?
- We usually prefer marketplace purchases for central billing. Do you support AWS Marketplace subscriptions for the Dedicated/hosted offering?
- Also: when does billing start - at end of the trial automatically, or only after we sign a paid quote? We want to avoid unexpected charges.

I've looped procurement on this email. Their contact is procurement@acmeco.com. If you can send the SOW + SOC2 and confirm the billing flow, Procurement will move to issue a PO.

Best,
Sara
Director, Product Ops | Acme Corp
sara@acmeco.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@acmeco.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Trial next steps & procurement checklist

Hi Sara, great questions, answers below:

- SOW & SOC 2: attaching SOC2-report.pdf here. We can draft a one-page SOW tailored to the SearchAssist pilot; I'll drop that in a follow-up if you want it merged into the quote.
- Trial payments/minimums: no advance payment required for the 30-day trial itself - the trial is free. If you choose to convert to a paid contract during or after the trial, billing begins when you accept the signed quote (or immediately if you subscribe via Marketplace). We will not auto-charge a card at trial end without explicit signoff.
- PO / Net30: we accept POs on our standard quote. Typical flow: we generate a quote + commercial terms, Acme signs (PO issued referencing the quote), and finance runs Net30. I've attached a draft quote (ACME-quote-20260711.pdf); this is editable based on final SKUs.
- Marketplace: yes, we support AWS Marketplace. If you prefer marketplace, billing will flow through AWS and will start when you activate the subscription there. That can be helpful for central procurement, but note the billing cadence and fees may differ slightly from direct invoices.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll send a one-page SOW by EOD Sun (7/12).
2) If Procurement confirms PO + Net30, Michael can prepare an official quote for signature and we'll route to finance.
3) If you prefer Marketplace, let us know and we'll create the listing link (this can add ~1-2 business days).

Attachments: SOC2-report.pdf, ACME-quote-20260711.pdf

Thanks - looking forward to getting onboarding scheduled once procurement is aligned.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Sara Patel <sara@acmeco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmeco.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Trial next steps & procurement checklist

Thanks, Marissa - Procurement confirms PO + Net30 is preferred. Procurement contact is Priya Natarajan (procurement@acmeco.com). They asked for the one-page SOW and the quote referenced in your email.

High-level timeline from our side: we aim to issue the PO by 2026-07-22 and start the trial onboarding the following week (target start 2026-07-27). Success criteria noted (10k/day, embedding recall > 0.95). If procurement needs to route via Marketplace for budget reasons, I'll flag that now, but the current plan is PO.

Sara
Director, Product Ops | Acme Corp
sara@acmeco.com
